exposure: Type of physician deciding cesarean delivery (general practitioner vs. other)
outcome: Proportion of non-medically indicated cesarean deliveries (NMIC)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery in 22 referral hospitals in Burkina Faso
finding: Nearly a quarter of cesarean deliveries in Burkina Faso were deemed non-medically indicated, highlighting potential overuse despite unmet needs for essential obstetric care.
mod_finding: Non-medically indicated cesarean deliveries were associated with urban residence, spouse having a non-agricultural occupation, and the decision for cesarean being made by a general practitioner.
